Next Talk to the team 02 System A management system, not a sticker.
Maripepa works with a quality management system in line with the ISO 9001 standard.
It is not a label to hang on the wall: it is the way processes, records and responsibilities are organised.
Traceability follows the product from reception to delivery, and the cold chain is looked after at every step.
That way, when something is asked, there is a well-founded answer.
If you need a sheet, an allergen or a storage condition, you ask the team and it is confirmed for the exact product.
Next Talk to the team 03 — Sheet Home Every reference has its sheet.
Every reference carries its sheet with ingredients, allergens, storage and format.
Ask for the one for the exact reference and keep it alongside its name or code.
If you need a sheet before deciding, give us the reference or, at least, the family and the format.
